name: shortcuts
title: Shortcuts
description: Keyboard shortcuts on UI SDK's shared shortcuts: useShortcut with scopes, sequences (g i) and mod, ShortcutScope for a region or an open panel, ShortcutHint drawn with Kbd. Plain keys never fire while typing or composing.
docs: `useShortcut(keys, handler, { scope, enabled, description, allowInInput, when, layer })` registers while mounted. Keys are `+`-joined (`mod+k`, `shift+?`), a space makes a two-step sequence (`g i`, 1.2 s apart at most), and `?` matches with or without Shift. Plain keys never run while focus is in an input, textarea or contenteditable, nor during IME composition. `<ShortcutScope name label active>` limits the shortcuts inside it: `active="focus"` (default) while focus is within, `true` while mounted (an open side panel), and inside a dialog they belong to that dialog. `ShortcutHint keys` draws the keys with `Kbd` (aria-hidden; give the control `aria-keyshortcuts`, which `useAriaKeyshortcuts` returns for single steps). `Button shortcut` and `DropdownMenuItem shortcut` bind and show a key. Shortcuts are a people-only accelerator: agents already press the same parts by name, so they gain nothing new.
